After every download started by the schedule has completed, the download notification stops and this screen closes. Android does not force-stop the app. A failure, pause, or another active download keeps it open. Items queued after that run stay held.

Scheduling is off. Downloads are not limited by a window.

End must be in the future.
On Android 12 and later, this window opens on time while the app is in the background only if exact alarms are allowed.
Exact alarms are allowed, so the window can open while the app is closed.
This Android version fires the window at the chosen time without an extra alarm permission.
One-time window. It does not repeat every day.
Downloads run only between the saved start and end.
Outside the window, active downloads pause. A download you paused yourself stays paused.
After the window ends, downloads stay paused until you clear the schedule.
The saved window is registered again after the device restarts.
